Welcome! I am Tuhinur Rahman Chowdhury, a PhD student and Graduate Instructor in Agricultural and Applied Economics at Texas Tech University. This site is where I share my research on labor markets, agricultural policy, and rural economics, along with course materials for my students and hands-on Python and Stata coding tutorials for fellow researchers and economists.

## What You Will Find Here

- **Research** — working papers, published work and ongoing projects
- **Teaching** — course materials, lecture notes and problem sets
- **Blog Posts** — data analysis tutorials using Python and Stata
- **Code** — reproducible econometric analysis and visualizations

Feel free to reach out at tuhchowd@ttu.edu for collaborations or questions!
